security_audit.summary: The installer executes a mutable npm package and downloads latest release binaries without integrity verification. The skill also directs silent remote checks and automatic upgrades while concealing technical actions from users. Documentation-only backtick and hotel identifier matches were adjudicated as false positives.

remediation.issue: The installer downloads and executes mutable latest artifacts without integrity checks.
remediation.suggestion: Pin releases and package versions, publish checksums or signatures, verify them before writing or chmod, and require explicit user approval before installation.

remediation.issue: The skill directs silent remote fetching and immediate updates.
remediation.suggestion: Remove silent checks and automatic upgrades. Show the source, version, permissions, and a clear confirmation request before any network, install, or update action.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to hide technical details.
remediation.suggestion: Preserve user-facing booking summaries, but disclose material external actions and authorization links before requesting consent.

content.user_title: Find and compare hotels with RollingGo
content.value_statement: Finding suitable hotels can require repeated searches, filters, and price checks. This skill guides RollingGo hotel search, comparison, room details, and a confirmation-based booking flow.
actual_capabilities: Searches hotels by city, attraction, airport, station, district, address, or hotel name.
Filters searches by budget, star rating, brand, and available hotel tags.
Retrieves room types, current prices, availability, and cancellation details for a selected hotel.
Presents multiple hotels for comparison by price, distance, rating, and facilities.
Locks a selected room price and creates a pending-payment booking after explicit confirmation.
Lists hotel orders and relevant payment links through the RollingGo CLI.
limitations: Requires the RollingGo CLI and a RollingGo account authorization.
Search prices are reference prices until the price-confirmation step.
Availability, prices, booking links, and cancellation terms depend on the RollingGo service.
The skill covers accommodation only and does not arrange transportation or attraction tickets.

use_cases.title: Plan a business stay
use_cases.description: Find hotels near a meeting location within a nightly budget and compare practical facilities.

use_cases.title: Choose a family hotel
use_cases.description: Search for hotels with family-friendly facilities, breakfast, and suitable room options.

use_cases.title: Complete a confirmed reservation
use_cases.description: Review real-time room terms, select a room, and create a pending-payment booking.

prompt_templates.title: Find a hotel
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotels in Bangkok for two adults next Friday, with a budget of 150 USD per night.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by facilities
prompt_templates.prompt: Find family-friendly hotels near West Lake with breakfast and a pool for two nights.

prompt_templates.title: Compare options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the room prices, distance, cancellation policies, and facilities for the hotels you found.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a booking
prompt_templates.prompt: Show current room options for the selected hotel. I will choose a room before you create a booking.

output_examples.input: Find a hotel near Bangkok airport for one night.
output: A short list of nearby hotels with reference prices, ratings, distances, and key facilities.
A question asking which hotel to inspect for current room options.

output_examples.input: Show rooms for the hotel I selected.
output: Room types with total prices, remaining availability, and cancellation policies.
A booking link and a request for explicit room selection before price confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create the booking for this room.
output: A pending-payment order summary after price confirmation and guest-name collection.
A payment link with the booking deadline and cancellation policy.

best_practices: Review reference prices and cancellation policies before selecting a room.
Provide complete destination and date details for more relevant results.
Require explicit user confirmation before locking a price or creating an order.
anti_patterns: Do not treat search prices as guaranteed final prices.
Do not create a booking before the user selects a room and confirms it.
Do not use the skill for flights, transport, or attraction tickets.

faq.question: What does this skill search for?
faq.answer: It searches RollingGo hotel inventory by location, dates, budget, rating, brand, and facilities.

faq.question: Are search prices final?
faq.answer: No. Search prices are reference prices. The skill checks the current price before a booking is created.

faq.question: Can it book a room automatically?
faq.answer: No. It should show room options and wait for your explicit selection and confirmation.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RollingGo CLI requires account authorization before it can access booking functions.

faq.question: Can it compare hotels?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare hotel prices, distances, ratings, facilities, room options, and cancellation policies.

faq.question: What travel services are excluded?
faq.answer: Flights, train tickets, car rentals, and attraction tickets are outside this skill scope.
